purpose: Test whether failed London opening-range breaks carry stronger immediate 30-second reversal economics than 17Z continuation entries.

source_basis.source: MQL5 Dynamic Session Range Sweep Detector
source_basis.logic: Locks a completed session range and defines a genuine liquidity sweep as a wick/pierce through the locked level followed by a close back inside.
Explicitly separates liquidity sweep-reversal from breakout-continuation across Asian/London transitions.
Documents XAUUSD London-open breakout traps and rapid retracement through breakout levels.

frozen_common.sweep: first strict tick beyond opening-range high or low
frozen_common.entry_direction: opposite the swept side after causal reclaim
frozen_common.ownership: one accepted reversal per UTC day; first sweep/reclaim sequence wins; no rearm
frozen_common.lifecycle: 0.01 lot; $0.30 stop; +$0.10 trail activation; $0.03 trail distance; 30s max hold; $0.02 RT commission

configs.C01_FIRST_TICK_RECLAIM: After first strict sweep, enter reversal on first later P75 Bid tick strictly back inside the swept boundary.
configs.C02_FIRST_COMPLETED_S5_RECLAIM: After sweep, require first completed S5 close back inside; execute first tick at/after close if still inside.
configs.C03_FIRST_COMPLETED_S15_RECLAIM: After sweep, require first completed S15 close back inside; execute first tick at/after close if still inside.

selection_rule: Advance only strong-pass config; prefer net, official wins, activity. No rescue tuning.
